plotEn:
During the US war in Afghanistan, Green Beret Ryan "Fang" Flanagan and his squad, consisting of Munch, Tanker and Wiz, are captured and held prisoner by the Taliban. Flanagan manages to escape and free his squad mates but Wiz dies before they are rescued. Flanagan is celebrated as a war hero but his experience in captivity leads to his marriage with his wife Tara breaking down.
Years later, during a dinner with Munch and Tanker to commemorate Wiz's death, Flanagan receives a call from Tara in hospital. She asks him to retrieve personal items from her abusive boyfriend Todd, a rich Louisville lawyer. Flanagan sneaks into Todd's house but is found and confronted by him. Todd accidentally shoots Flanagan in the leg, leading him to fight back in self-defence after he has a PTSD episode. In the struggle, they tumble off a balcony and Todd dies from a head injury. Told that the police had already been called and unwilling to become a prisoner again, Flanagan steals a Shelby Mustang from Todd's garage and flees.
Flanagan leads police on a chase through Kentucky, using the car's AI assistant to plot a course to Texas. CNN reporter Laura Coates gets in contact with Flanagan, bringing greater attention to his plight from the public. Tanker and Munch steal a helicopter to aid Flanagan, while Texas Highway Patrol Major Walter Pope becomes adamant on stopping Flanagan at any cost.
